Custom Container Home Manufacturer

With the development of economy, the demand for housing is increasing, and many people want their own house with proper price and good quality. Some countries or regions are limited by local factors, which makes traditional housing unable to meet people's needs.

The emergence of container home has solved this problem well, and more and more people choose prefab container house with proper price and good quality. [Location] NEW BRAND as a professional container home manufacturer which is committed to bringing high-quality and low-cost custom container house to people all over the world.

Customized Service

After the customer determines what kind of house is needed, NEW BRAND will send the customized parts of the corresponding house to the customer for selection, and the customer can also put forward his ideas according to his own needs. We will discuss its feasibility with the designer, and finally confirm the renderings according to the customer's needs, and start production after confirming the details.

Custom Solutions—Built to Last, Tailored to Your Needs

◎    Size and Structure: 10ft, 20ft, 40ft, or fully custom sizes. Single units, multi-container combinations, or up to 3-story stacked builds. All frames undergo hot-dip galvanization and are coated with anti-corrosion finishes to withstand harsh climates and coastal environments.
◎   Floor Plans: Open layouts, multi-bedroom units, commercial buildings, dormitory units, industrial storage, mobile offices, emergency housing units, medical rooms, and more.  You only provide sketches or full blueprints, and our design team will assist with the rest.
◎   Wall Panels: All insulated wall panels are reinforced with proprietary bonding technology, enhancing the structural strength and weather resistance of the container framework.
◎   Ceilings and Interior Finishes: Our 831 ceiling system delivers a cleaner finish than standard non-bonded components. Flooring, wall cladding, and lighting layouts are fully customizable across various materials and styles.
◎   Exterior and Color: Corrugated metal panels, wood-grain composite, or fiber cement boards—all available in custom RAL colors to match your brand or design vision.
◎   Roof Structure: Every prefab building incorporates steel plate reinforcement in the roof to prevent damage during transport and unloading—a critical detail ensuring your structure arrives intact.
◎   Off-Grid Systems: Modular container homes can be equipped with complete plumbing, electrical, solar integration, battery storage, and pre-wiring. Designed for on-grid connections or fully off-grid deployment.
◎   Furniture and Accessories Packaging: All fragile built-in components are shipped in individual wooden crates—ensuring products leave the factory intact and arrive undamaged at your construction site.

Have a Container Home project in mind? Contact us with your requirements, and we'll get back to you within 24 hours with a custom quote.

Why Choose NEW BRAND as Your Manufacturer

Our manufacturing capabilities are driven by a [Capacity to be supplied]-square-foot facility with four specialized workshops, featuring advanced roll forming machines for burr-free edges and epoxy flooring for a dust-free environment. Our in-house operations handle all welding, cutting, bending, panel installation, and finishing to maintain a rapid production pace of 500 sets per day.
The prefab home product quality has been verified by many testing institutions, and the feedback from qualified customers is very good.
More than 10 years' experience in container home production makes it possible to keep up with market demand in terms of production cycle and structural optimization.
Compared to market prices, our prices may not be the cheapest, but considering the overall quality and price, our factory is a worthwhile choice.
Our factory has been deeply involved in the prefab house industry for more than 10 years, and has rich experience in production and customization. Most customization needs in the market can be met, and 3D renderings can be made in time to confirm details according to customers' needs.
We have a professional foreign trade team capable of precisely meeting all customer requirements. Additionally, the company employs dedicated logistics and quality control personnel to ensure products are shipped intact from the factory.
Timely delivery and ability to handle various urgent orders; the upgraded machine can more effectively prevent groundwater from seeping into the floor through the square pipe.

Custom Process
1. Design
Draw corresponding 3D renderings according to customers' needs to confirm details, communicate with customers and confirm local standards.
2. Proposal and Contract Documents
After confirming the details with the customer, prepare the contract, which will indicate the product parameters and other contents that reflect the customer's customized needs, and send them to the customer for confirmation and pay the deposit.
3. Production
Determine the shipping schedule and arrange production according to customer's requirements.
4. Packing & Loading
After the production is completed, it is packed according to the shipping schedule. The packing methods usually include film covering and bubble film, and the container is loaded with cranes and forklifts.
5. Shipment & Delivery
After the customer pays the final payment, contact the freight forwarder to determine the shipping date, book the shipping space and arrange the delivery.
6. Installation
We will provide online guidance and installation videos after customers arrive, and provide one-on-one guidance services during customer installation to ensure that customers can install them well.

Multiple Design & Flooring Options

01
We can provide customized container house solutions based on the specific needs of our clients, and offer a one-stop service from material selection to interior layout, thus creating the perfect home in our clients' minds.
02
Common flooring materials include PVC, SPC, and WPC flooring. PVC and SPC flooring are commonly used for indoor flooring and are available in a variety of colors. WPC flooring is often used for outdoor patios due to its good water resistance and corrosion resistance.

Container House Showcase

Customized Container Homes: NEW BRAND manufactures and sells prefabricated container homes, including expandable container houses, foldable container homes, detachable container homes, flat-pack container homes, and space capsule houses. All container homes can be customized to meet client requirements, from interior layout and decoration to exterior finishes and thermal insulation panels. This high level of customization fulfills clients' personalized needs.

Applications Of NEW BRAND
Apple Cabin
The Apple Cabin (sometimes referred to as the Apple Pod) is a prefabricated portable micro-home characterized by sleek lines, rounded corners, and a minimalist high-tech aesthetic reminiscent of a fashion capsule.

They are constructed with galvanized steel frames, which offer structural integrity. These tiny houses are typically “prefabricated,” meaning they are fully assembled in a factory before being shipped to the site. Apple Cabins require no permanent foundation (typically only level ground or concrete footings), making them portable with trailers.
Expandable Container Home
Expandable container homes typically include multiple bedrooms, plumbing, bathrooms, and kitchen infrastructure. A standard 20-foot container home measures approximately 160 square feet, while expandable homes can reach around 400–800 square feet—sufficient for 2 to 3 bedrooms.

These expandable container homes typically feature galvanized steel frames and sandwich panels (EPS or polyurethane) for insulation. Since they fold down to standard ISO container dimensions, they can be shipped worldwide.
Detachable Container Home
Detachable container homes offer a modern and cost-effective solution for diverse applications, including temporary housing, disaster relief, and commercial spaces. These structures are easy to assemble and disassemble, allowing for relocation and reconfiguration to meet evolving needs.

Detachable container houses can be customized to meet specific requirements serving in residential, industrial, and commercial settings. In summary, modular container homes deliver a versatile and adaptable housing solution that combines convenience, sustainability, and affordability.
Folding Container House
Foldable container houses are modular, movable structures that combine rapid assembly, flexibility, and durability. Deployed and assembled in just 30 minutes, they provide ready-to-use living units or workspaces.

Foldable container homes represent a new generation of housing solutions, blending sustainability and portability. They serve as flexible options for on-site offices or mobile workspaces at construction sites or remote locations, as well as emergency shelters for disaster relief or humanitarian aid.

FAQ

1
What are the benefits of a custom container house?
Customized container houses can better meet the needs of customers, and there is no need to wait for the second adjustment after receiving the house, which can reduce the threshold for use.
2
Is your container house installation service free?
We currently only provide online installation guidance and installation video, if the customer wants to install locally, they need to contact the installation company, larger projects we can provide workers to the customer's local installation, but the customer needs to pay the corresponding fee.
3
What is the lifespan of a container home?
Container house lifespan usually have 20-30 years.
4
How long is the warranty for your container house?
Our container house have three years warranty, we can provide materials for free if our house have any quality questions(not human made broken.
5
Are the materials used to make your container houses environmentally friendly?
The materials we use to make our container houses are all recyclable and eco-friendly materials that can be reused. Compared with traditional houses, it is more environmentally friendly.
6
Our company's house is a customized product, and the specific price needs to be determined with the customer before quoting.
Container house is a customized product, and the different needs of different customers will also make the price of the house different, please contact our sales for a specific quotation.
